svg.title: The four loops, one trip at a time
svg.desc: An animation of compute_path() on a 4 by 4 grid, with the four loops listed beside it. Trip one, (0, 0) to (2, 3): east runs twice, appending (1, 0) and (2, 0); west is skipped; north runs three times, appending (2, 1), (2, 2) and (2, 3); south is skipped; five steps. Trip two, (3, 3) to (1, 0): east is skipped; west runs twice, (2, 3) and (1, 3); north is skipped; south runs three times, (1, 2), (1, 1), (1, 0); five steps. Trip three, (1, 1) to (1, 1): all four loops are skipped and the path is empty. A red dot steps along each move and each appended spot is numbered by its index.
svg.text: The four loops, one trip at a time
At most one x loop and one y loop run;
the others find their condition False on
the first check and do nothing.

g.text: x > 2 is 2 > 2: False at the first check
y > 3 is 3 > 3: False at the first check
x < 1 is 3 < 1: False at the first check
y < 0 is 3 < 0: False at the first check
x < 1 is 1 < 1: False at the first check
x > 1 is 1 > 1: False at the first check
y < 1 is 1 < 1: False at the first check
y > 1 is 1 > 1: False at the first check
